source_text: Ὁδοὶ δύο εἰσὶν διδαχῆς καὶ ἐξουσίας, ἥ τε τοῦ φωτὸς καὶ ἡ τοῦ σκότους. διαφορὰ δὲ πολλὴ τῶν δύο ὁδῶν. ἐφ’ ἧς μὲν γάρ εἰσιν τεταγμένοι φωταγωγοὶ ἄγγελοι τοῦ θεοῦ, ἐφ’ ἧς δὲ ἄγγελοι τοῦ σατανᾶ. καὶ ὁ μέν ἐστιν κύριος ἀπὸ αἰώνων καὶ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας, ὁ δὲ ἄρχων καιροῦ τοῦ νῦν τῆς ἀνομίας.
pass_a_gloss: There are two ways of teaching and authority, of light and of darkness; much difference between the two ways; on one are stationed light-bearing angels of God, on the other angels of Satan; the one is Lord from ages to ages, the other ruler of the present season of lawlessness.
pass_b_english: There are two ways of teaching and of authority: the way of light and the way of darkness. And the difference between the two ways is great. Over the one stand light-bearing angels of God; over the other, angels of Satan. The one is Lord from ages to ages; the other is the ruler of the present age of lawlessness.

choices.why: Literal compound; angelic guides of the light-way.
